clue.text: Artist's second record admitted by criminal court

indicators.note: admitted by says one piece is let inside the other
criminal suggests something crooked, so the letters of court are bent into a new order

parts.note: an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.walkthrough: The definition is 'Artist' with the 's standing for 'is'. 'criminal' gives CUTOR, and 'admitted by' takes the record inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sculptor is one kind of artist, working in stone, metal or clay.

clue.text: Rent, with advance sale collapsing on beginning of exchange

beginning of picks the opening letter of the word exchange

explanation.surface: A property rental falls through when an advance sale collapses at the start of the exchange of contracts.
explanation.definitionFit: To sublease is to rent out a property one is already renting oneself, so the verb works as rent.

clue.text: Powerful traditions constrain such an extremist

indicators.note: constrain says the two words hold the answer locked within them, across the gap

explanation.surface: Strong traditions keep a fanatic in check.
explanation.definitionFit: An ultra is someone holding extreme views, a hardliner in politics or religion.

clue.text: Stick out for a planned undertaking

definitions.meaning: to jut or protrude beyond a surface
a scheme or piece of organised work

explanation.surface: Persevere with a planned enterprise.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means protrude; as a noun it means a scheme of work.

clue.text: Throw out leader ducking mediaeval tournament

explanation.definitionFit: To oust someone is to expel or remove them from a position.

clue.text: A decent chap, mostly chasing fine material

explanation.definitionFit: Fabric is cloth, any woven or knitted textile material.

clue.text: Legal case covering university sale

indicators.note: covering says the first piece wraps around the second

parts.note: an action is a lawsuit or legal case

explanation.definitionFit: An auction is a public sale where goods go to the highest bidder.

clue.text: People well-placed in the race for gold?

parts.words: People well-placed in the race for gold?

explanation.surface: Contenders in a strong position to win a gold medal.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the twist: those 'well-placed' did not take gold, but came second or close behind.

clue.text: Rough rows in church

clue.text: Lively pub's motto offering cheers

indicators.note: lively suggests energetic movement, so the letters of the pub's motto jump about into a new order

clue.text: Spend some money on getting a grip

definitions.meaning: a firm hold or foothold, leverage

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means buy; as a noun it means a firm hold or leverage.

for says another letter takes its place

parts.note: Congo is a country in central Africa
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.walkthrough: 'love' is the tennis score of nothing, the letter O.

clue.text: Delighted journalist after having seen story rejected

explanation.definitionFit: Elated means overjoyed, in high spirits.

clue.text: Teachers seeing riddles initially dismissed

explanation.definitionFit: Trainers are coaches or instructors, people who teach skills.

clue.text: Bad spellers test patience of this city

parts.note: a coven is a gathering of witches, who cast wicked spells
to try someone is to test their patience

explanation.surface: Poor spellers sorely tax the patience of a city's people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spellers' looks like people who spell badly, but means casters of spells. Coventry is a city in the English Midlands.

clue.text: Words of love now — he's setting out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are set out afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: A romantic declaration made now as he heads out.

clue.text: Steps up, being formerly involved in unusual cases

unusual says the letters of cases appear in a different order

parts.note: late means former, as in the late president

explanation.surface: Things intensify, having once been mixed up in strange lawsuits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' gives ESCAS, which 'involved in' splits around the word for formerly.
explanation.definitionFit: To escalate is to intensify or increase, so the plural verb matches 'steps up'.

clue.text: Horses needed by rag-and-bone men crossing river

parts.note: totters is British slang for rag-and-bone men, street collectors of scrap and old goods

explanation.walkthrough: Rag-and-bone men were British street traders who bought junk from a horse-drawn cart, called totters.

clue.text: Cleaner reprimands person in tears

parts.note: to carpet someone is to haul them up for a telling-off

clue.text: Like a monarch — one with answer for badges of office

parts.note: regal means kingly or queenly
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A kingly figure, plus one with a response, in exchange for insignia.
explanation.definitionFit: Regalia are the emblems and insignia of royalty or rank, such as crown and sceptre.

clue.text: New money will cover firm for financial system

indicators.note: will cover says the rearranged letters wrap around the firm
new says the letters of money are made over in a fresh arrangement

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

explanation.walkthrough: 'New' gives ENOMY, and 'will cover' wraps it round the firm.
explanation.definitionFit: An economy is the system of production, trade and money in a country.

clue.text: Prince with no crown must protect the empty blood line

with no crown says the top letter of the name is taken off

indicators.note: empty says the word the is cleared of its middle, keeping only its ends

clue.text: Demote European envoy after resistance

indicators.note: after says these pieces come behind the resistance letter

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance
a legate is an envoy, especially of the Pope

clue.text: Element that's key on horse

indicators.note: on says the key comes after the horse in this across answer

parts.note: a cob is a sturdy short-legged horse
Alt is a key on a computer keyboard

explanation.definitionFit: Cobalt is a metallic chemical element, number 27.

clue.text: Humble a graduate — she has no heart

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts graduate

indicators.note: has no heart says the middle letter of she is taken out

explanation.surface: A graduate is cold and unfeeling.

clue.text: Test part of door alarmed

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An exam set off part of the door alarm.

clue.text: Sing the praises of former tax cut

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

parts.note: a toll is a charge or levy, a tax for using a road or bridge

explanation.definitionFit: To extol is to praise highly, to laud.

clue.text: New foal ready for a long drink

indicators.note: new says the letters are put together afresh in another order

explanation.surface: A newborn horse ready for a big drink.

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a tall glass and the beer it holds, literally a long drink.

clue.text: No reply from this worker is out of the question

definitions.text: No reply from this worker is out of the question

clue.text: Barred areas for young song writer in case of process
